mainEntity.name: What is the process for beginning an exterior stair construction project with Hometelligent Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, functional needs, and budget for the exterior stairs. We then conduct a site visit to assess the existing conditions, take measurements, and identify any challenges or specific requirements. Based on this, we develop a detailed proposal including design options, material recommendations, project scope, and a transparent cost estimate. Once approved, we handle permitting and schedule the construction, keeping you informed throughout the project until completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process starts with a consultation and site visit, followed by a detailed proposal, permit handling, and scheduled construction with ongoing client communication.
